🎓 About AbhiHub

Built by students.
For students.

A student-powered academic knowledge platform for engineering PYQs, notes, and practicals.

Our Mission

AbhiHub exists to make high-quality academic knowledge accessible, structured, and reliable for every engineering student.

Students often struggle with scattered resources, inconsistent quality, and outdated materials. AbhiHub centralises verified notes, previous-year questions, and practical resources — contributed by students and organised for instant discovery.

Our long-term vision is a scalable academic knowledge infrastructure that grows with its community and supports students throughout their entire learning journey.
